prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original anime RPG game transparent sprite animation atlas. Make ONE uniformly aligned atlas, exactly 14 columns and 8 rows, NO gaps NO text NO borders. All 112 cells same size, full body standing character centered with feet at same bottom baseline; transparent background. Detailed polished 3D anime chibi style, warm Vietnam fantasy kitchen spirits. Rows respectively: orange fox warrior with scarf, blue carp dragon mage, green deer herbal healer, golden rice lion guardian, lavender rabbit star mage, young Vietnamese lantern keeper in indigo tunic, golden buffalo warrior with peanut armor, pale ink shadow puppet enemy. Columns depict genuine articulated animation poses in this order: 0 neutral idle; 1 left walking step; 2 walking passing pose; 3 right walking step; 4 walking passing pose; 5 attack windup; 6 attack swing; 7 attack recovery; 8 casting windup; 9 spell release; 10 casting recovery; 11 hit recoil; 12 collapsed defeat on ground; 13 victory raised arms. Preserve same character identity, costume, size and camera within each row. Camera fixed three-quarter front, each character faces screen-right, no camera cuts. Distinct limb poses, feet cycling, weapons move. Do not put scenery or huge spells inside cells. Entire character remains within own cell. Clear readable silhouettes. Original designs, no franchise characters. Canvas wide, 14:8 ratio.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE anime RPG NPC portrait atlas, exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, equal rectangular cells, no gutters no text no borders. Warm painterly 3D anime RPG illustration, Vietnamese fantasy night market. Each cell contains one distinct waist-up person centered, soft dark teal background. Row1 col1 An: young Vietnamese adult woman lantern-maker, dark hair tied with amber ribbon, indigo tunic, small glowing paper lantern, curious determined expression. Row1 col2 Ong Loc: kind elderly Vietnamese male lantern craftsman with silver beard, linen brown tunic and wooden tools. Row1 col3 Ba Sen: welcoming middle-aged Vietnamese woman cook, plum ao ba ba, cooking ladle. Row2 col1 Tinh: composed middle-aged male scholar in midnight blue traditional tunic, black hair, white recipe manuscript, conflicted eyes. Row2 col2 Story recorder: young Vietnamese male scribe, jade tunic, bamboo scroll. Row2 col3 faceless luminous ink-memory spirit with elegant pale silhouette. Cohesive character design, detailed eyes and fabrics, cinematic soft lantern lighting. No lettering, no logos, no text.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE 2 by 2 scene atlas, exactly four equal widescreen panels, no gaps borders labels or text. Highly polished anime 3D RPG environments, Vietnam-inspired fantasy, moonlit teal and warm amber lanterns. Top left: busy old Vietnamese night market courtyard, paper lanterns, timber stalls with rice bowls and bamboo baskets, open central space suitable for tactical board overlay. Top right: riverside communal kitchen with gently steaming pots, tropical trees, wooden bridges and empty chair set for a guest. Bottom left: mysterious recipe archive with bamboo shelves, floating pale ink pages, cool blue lighting, red lantern reflections. Bottom right: dawn courtyard communal long table, scattered lanterns, warm sunlight, inviting chairs and blossoms, magical mist dissolving. No main characters, NO printed signs or readable text. Rich cultural texture without copying a real monument; original fantasy game. Consistent camera three-quarter elevated. Each panel standalone, clean distinct atmospheric backdrop.

Use case stylized-concept. ONE transparent anime 3D chibi RPG enemy animation atlas. Exactly 7 columns by 14 rows, uniform cells, NO text, NO borders, NO gaps. Original fantasy Vietnam night market lore, not real deities or franchise monsters. Clear different silhouettes, expressive articulated limbs and distinct actual movement between columns. Entire creature fits each cell. Spell effect small enough inside cell. Portrait canvas 1:2 ratio.

Use case photorealistic-natural. ONE food photography atlas exactly 2 columns and 5 rows, each equal square cell, no gutters text labels borders.
